title: 沙箱逃脱
style: Hyper-speed heist drill with skittering hi-hats, tense sub pulses, and chopped siren accents; verse rides lean and sprinting, pre-chorus tightens into clipped chant lines, chorus slams with gang shouts and a half-time hook. Mandarin lead vocal with English licks, stacked doubles on the hook, short delay throws on key phrases. Ear candy: vault-door slams, reversed risers, radio chatter stutters. Bright, aggressive, glossy mix., bounce, rock, fake
